entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit support. My name is David. How can I assist you today?
Hi David... I'm calling because I need to return something, and I just feel awful about it. I'm hoping you can help.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into the return for you. To start, could I get your full name and order number, please?
Of course. It's Maria Valenti, order number is VF655321. I've been a customer for years, I really hope this isn't an issue.

Thank you, Maria. I see your account here and we definitely appreciate your loyalty. I'm looking at the order now... I see the V-Secure road helmet. Can you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

It's just a preference, which is why I feel so bad. The **color** in person wasn't what I expected from the website. I ordered it for a big charity ride, but I just couldn't bring myself to wear it. It's been sitting here, and the **box** is completely **unopened**.

I understand completely. We want you to love the gear you're in, especially when it comes to **safety** equipment like a **helmet**. Let me just review the return eligibility for this item. One moment.
Okay, thank you. I was just really hoping to get that money back for some holiday expenses. It would make a huge difference.

Alright Maria, I've checked the policy. It looks like the delivery was 69 days ago, and for this item, we have a 90-day return window. So you are well within the timeframe. I can go ahead and approve this return for a full refund for you.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! Thank you so much, David. I was so worried I had waited too long.

Not at all. And because you're a VIP member and the item is in its original packaging, I'm going to waive the return shipping fee for you. I've just sent a prepaid return label to the email on your account. Just print that out, attach it to the box, and you can drop it off at any postal service.
Wow, that's amazing. You've really made my day! Thank you for making that so easy.
It's my pleasure. We value your business. Once our warehouse receives the helmet, your refund will be issued within 3-5 business days. Was there anything else I could help with today?
No, that's everything. You've been wonderful. Thanks again!
You're very welcome, Maria. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
